text_block_list.text:
With the Mile CS just one month away,
the three of us, including Fine Motion,
decided to talk.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Princess.
Thank you for granting me this audience.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: It's been since the Yasuda Kinen that I last ran in a race, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
My knight, have you been well?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is all mine.
I am delighted to have this time to converse with you.

Their time together begins with an excessively polite greeting.
As if following a traditional, stylized ritual.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I was still far from reaching
your level of dignity and grace. However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now, I hesitate no longer.
I have honed both my sword and my heart to perfection..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please see for yourself in the main event.
And starting next year, as someone who stands alongside you...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Next year... and beyond...
Ah, umm...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, Trainer,
about that... you see.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Returning home...!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Are you going back to Ireland?
Then what about racing...?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think this year's
Mile CS will be my last.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It was only a three-year promise to begin with.
They were just temporarily indulging my selfish wish to race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
But... please don't be sad.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't want a lonely ending.
At the very, very end, I want to run the ultimate race,
and hopefully, crown it with a glorious victory—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I intend to go home thoroughly satisfied. âª
If I can defeat Durandal as she is now,
I could ask for nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it would've been great if I could just keep running forever...
but things can't stay unchanged forever."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I can't... stay the same forever...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Princess, you too...

One of the irreplaceable Umamusume to Durandal.
And she's about to be gone.
It wasn't just the relationship between an Umamusume and her Trainer that couldn't remain the same forever.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My King. Is it truly acceptable to let our great benefactor,
the Princess, depart just like this?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there may be unavoidable circumstances
forcing her to return. However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to give anything back yet.
Even though you've taught me so much...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I won't have a leg to stand on as a knight.
If there is even just one thing I can do..."
choice_data_list: You're right, I feel the exact same way.
Yeah, I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.text:
Of course I want to make the Mile CS
the best race possible. But...

That alone won't be enough.
I need something memorable to give Fine Motion
in return...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yeah...
If you really insist on a return gift, then...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Grant me victory! ...Just kidding♪
I'll be sure to accomplish that myself anyway...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know! There's something
I'd like you to tell me♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Something you want to know? From me to a princess?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because surely there are things Durandal and Trainer know
that I don't understand yet.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: About the “Ideal Master and Servant.”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: An ideal... master and servant?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, since I was studying abroad for so long,
I still don't fully understand what it means
to be served by retainers or adored by the people.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I stay as I am now, I don't know
if I can properly fulfill my duties even if I go back...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Because the three years I was supposed to spend learning that were spent on racing instead."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Still, you and Durandal both understand dedicating yourselves to others—and being dedicated to in return, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "I have never known a master and servant with a bond as strong as yours. That is why..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want you to tell me.
How I ought to be.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see...
The ideal master and servant... So that's it...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: She believed that showing the true essence of the relationship between myself and the King would be the greatest way to repay her gratitude.
Even when told that, I don't really know what I'm supposed to show them, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wah! Will you teach me?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll think about what's truly important.
Yeah, I'll think about what's truly important.

text_block_list.text: How I feel about Durandal, and how Durandal feels about me.

"Let's give it form and share it.
Not just basking in idle adoration, but showing that 'this is what an ideal relationship looks like.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That would be a great help. You truly are the person I took you for.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I feel bad relying on you so much,
but I'm counting on you♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, don't hold back—tell me anything!
Yeah, don't hold back, tell me anything!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(What's with... this friendly vibe...?
Was she always like this?)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(We've interacted a lot before this.
Still, we shouldn't have been this close...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(There are probably things only kings can understand about each other.
Even so...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I can't just leave this alone!
What is this...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King! You must not!
Great as our debt of gratitude may be, she is still your racing rival.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Do not approach any further.
Be pure! Be righteous! We shall only repay our debt of gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Be that as it may... Your Highness, as you wish.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I will be sure to bring you an answer
you can be satisfied with by the Mile CS."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Durandal. Then together with victory,
I shall bring back that answer.
I accepted the task, but...
choice_data_list: I wonder what the ideal master-servant relationship is.
I wonder what the ideal master-servant relationship is.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "...Indeed. The King has bestowed so much upon me. In return, however—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I offered up countless achievements as well.
Numerous victories, glory, fame, trophies...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "However, I feel that what was received or given is not truly the heart of the matter."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is true that time spent with my King is a treasure.
However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: If this is not meant to last forever.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even as eras shift,
if there is something that still remains...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That's... most likely...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, I cannot see it clearly yet either.
However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
One possibility comes to mind.
Whether it is the correct one or not, however...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I think I shall see for myself on the day of the Mile CS.
Together with you, while competing against the princess."
